title: VS-26 — Google Place Intelligence & Goal-First Onboarding

notes: VS-26 reuses the existing Google Place ID location-resolution boundary and does not create a second identity matcher.
Rich Google Places attributes are interaction-transient. Only the Place ID is retained as Google provider content.
Canonical operating context is persisted only through an explicit owner submit/confirm action; copied Google payloads and hidden Google-derived facts are not persisted.
Goals remain owner-only and move ahead of optional non-goal progressive context.
For sufficiently enriched Businesses optional non-goal context targets 0–3 questions; five remains only the degraded/missing-context ceiling.
The approved Atlas design baseline remains authoritative; no navigation redesign or new visual system is in scope.
No production release, production enablement, EAS build/submit/OTA or deployment is authorized.

approvals.rationale: Product Owner approved the VS-26 design and implementation plan covering bounded Place enrichment, compact owner confirmation, Goals-first onboarding and redundant-question suppression.

Product Owner approved proceeding under the execution-time Google policy refinement recorded in DEC-08: Place ID retention only for Google provider content, transient rich attributes, explicit owner-submitted canonical persistence, required attribution and no Google Maps HTML scraping.
Product Owner explicitly instructed 'Check now and proceed' after approving the VS-26 plan. Runtime implementation is authorized on a fresh branch from merged VS-25 main.
